abacus.example_en: My grandfather still adds numbers quickly on a wooden abacus.
abacus.example_zh: 我爷爷仍用一把木算盘快速做加法。

academy.example_en: She won a place at a music academy after the spring audition.
academy.example_zh: 春季选拔之后，她考进了一所音乐学院。

accidentally.example_en: I accidentally knocked over the soy sauce during dinner.
accidentally.example_zh: 晚饭时，我不小心打翻了酱油。

accountant.example_en: My aunt works as an accountant in a small city office.
accountant.example_zh: 我姑姑在市里一家小办公室当会计。

adjective.example_en: She asked which adjective best describes her new hairstyle.
adjective.example_zh: 她问哪个形容词最能形容她的新发型。

admiration.example_en: The crowd showed real admiration when she finished the long race.
admiration.example_zh: 她跑完长跑时，人群流露出由衷的钦佩。

advertiser.example_en: The advertiser paid the school team to wear those new shirts.
advertiser.example_zh: 广告商付钱让校队穿上那些新球衣。

advertising.example_en: Bright advertising covered the walls of the subway station.
advertising.example_zh: 鲜艳的广告贴满了地铁站的墙壁。

aeroplane.example_en: Our aeroplane landed in Guangzhou just before the heavy rain.
aeroplane.example_zh: 大雨来临前，我们的飞机降落在广州。

afterwards.example_en: We played basketball and went for noodles afterwards.
afterwards.example_zh: 我们打完篮球，后来去吃了面条。

agricultural.example_en: The agricultural museum shows old tools from rice farms.
agricultural.example_zh: 农业博物馆展出稻田里用过的旧农具。

alcoholic.example_en: This fruit drink is not alcoholic, so students may buy it.
alcoholic.example_zh: 这种果汁饮料不含酒精，所以学生可以买。

alphabet.example_en: Can you sing the alphabet from A to Z without stopping?
alphabet.example_zh: 你能不停顿地从A唱到Z，把字母表唱完吗？

alphabetical.example_en: Please put the library cards in alphabetical order before lunch.
alphabetical.example_zh: 午饭前请把图书卡按字母顺序排好。

alphabetically.example_en: The class list is arranged alphabetically by family name.
alphabetically.example_zh: 班级名单按姓氏字母顺序排列。

amaze.example_en: Street magicians amaze tourists near the shopping mall every weekend.
amaze.example_zh: 每个周末，街头魔术师都在商场附近让游客大吃一惊。

amusing.example_en: The cartoon was so amusing that we laughed through lunch.
amusing.example_zh: 那部动画片太有趣了，我们整个午饭都在笑。

announcement.example_en: An announcement asked passengers to board the ferry at Gate 3.
announcement.example_zh: 一则通知请乘客在3号门登上渡船。

anymore.example_en: I do not take the late bus anymore because it is too slow.
anymore.example_zh: 我不再坐那班晚班车了，因为它太慢。

apology.example_en: He sent a short apology after missing his friend's birthday party.
apology.example_zh: 他错过朋友的生日聚会后，发来了一句简短的道歉。

applause.example_en: Loud applause filled the hall when the choir finished singing.
applause.example_zh: 合唱团唱完时，热烈的掌声充满了大厅。

arctic.example_en: Arctic animals appear on the posters in our science corner.
arctic.example_zh: 我们科学角的海报上有北极动物。

armchair.example_en: Dad fell asleep in the armchair while the match was on.
armchair.example_zh: 比赛还在进行时，爸爸在扶手椅上睡着了。

assist.example_en: Can you assist me with these heavy boxes from the shop?
assist.example_zh: 你能帮我搬这些从店里拿来的重箱子吗？

astronomy.example_en: Our astronomy club meets on the roof when the sky is clear.
astronomy.example_zh: 天晴时，我们的天文社团在屋顶活动。

attraction.example_en: The night market is the main attraction for visitors in summer.
attraction.example_zh: 夜市是夏天最吸引游客的地方。

aviary.example_en: Colourful birds flew around the large aviary in the city park.
aviary.example_zh: 色彩鲜艳的鸟在城市公园的大鸟笼里飞来飞去。

bad-tempered.example_en: The bad-tempered dog barked at everyone who passed the gate.
bad-tempered.example_zh: 那只脾气坏的狗对每个经过大门的人都叫。

bald.example_en: My bald uncle wears a cap whenever he plays football.
bald.example_zh: 我那位秃头叔叔每次踢足球都戴着帽子。

bead.example_en: She threaded a blue bead onto the bracelet for her sister.
bead.example_zh: 她把一颗蓝珠子穿到了给妹妹的手链上。

beam.example_en: A bright beam of sunlight came through the classroom window.
beam.example_zh: 一道明亮的阳光从教室窗户照了进来。

beg.example_en: Please do not beg me for sweets before dinner is ready.
beg.example_zh: 晚饭还没好，请别央求我要糖果。

bicycle.example_en: I ride my bicycle to school when the weather stays dry.
bicycle.example_zh: 天气一直干燥时，我就骑自行车上学。

blink.example_en: Do not blink when the camera flash goes off for the photo.
blink.example_zh: 拍照闪光灯亮起时不要眨眼。

blond.example_en: The blond boy in the red jersey scored the winning goal.
blond.example_zh: 穿红球衣的金发男孩踢进了制胜一球。

bodyguard.example_en: A tall bodyguard stood beside the singer at the concert gate.
bodyguard.example_zh: 一名高个保镖站在演唱会门口歌手的身旁。

bookshop.example_en: We stopped at a bookshop near the station to buy comics.
bookshop.example_zh: 我们在车站附近的书店停下来买漫画。

boom.example_en: Tourism brought a boom to the small seaside town last year.
boom.example_zh: 旅游业去年给这座海滨小镇带来了繁荣。

brainpower.example_en: Chess needs brainpower, patience, and a quiet place to think.
brainpower.example_zh: 下棋需要脑力、耐心，以及一个安静的思考之处。

briefly.example_en: She briefly checked the map before we left the metro station.
briefly.example_zh: 离开地铁站前，她简短地看了看地图。

bronze.example_en: Visitors can touch a bronze bell outside the history museum.
bronze.example_zh: 游客可以触摸历史博物馆外面的一口青铜钟。

bubble.example_en: A soap bubble floated over the playground and then burst.
bubble.example_zh: 一个肥皂泡飘过操场，然后破了。

bucket.example_en: Fill this bucket with water before you wash the car.
bucket.example_zh: 洗车前先把这只桶装满水。

bug.example_en: A tiny bug landed on my sandwich during the picnic.
bug.example_zh: 野餐时，一只小虫子落在我的三明治上。

bulletproof.example_en: The museum displays a bulletproof vest used by city police.
bulletproof.example_zh: 博物馆展出一件市警察局用过的防弹背心。

burst.example_en: The water balloon will burst if you squeeze it too hard.
burst.example_zh: 你要是捏得太用力，水气球就会爆裂。

bus-stop.example_en: Wait for me at the bus-stop opposite the sports centre.
bus-stop.example_zh: 在体育中心对面的公共汽车站等我。

bye.example_en: She waved and said bye before running to catch the train.
bye.example_zh: 她挥手说了再见，然后跑去赶火车。

cable.example_en: The worker fixed a loose cable behind the classroom television.
cable.example_zh: 工人修好了教室电视机后面一根松动的电缆。

calculation.example_en: Check your calculation before you write the final answer.
calculation.example_zh: 写下最终答案之前，先核对你的计算。

calculator.example_en: I forgot my calculator and had to work out the sums by hand.
calculator.example_zh: 我忘了带计算器，只好用手把这些题算出来。

carnival.example_en: The street carnival filled the square with music and bright lights.
carnival.example_zh: 街头狂欢节让广场充满了音乐和明亮的灯光。

carriage.example_en: We found empty seats in the last carriage of the train.
carriage.example_zh: 我们在火车最后一节车厢找到了空位。

cart.example_en: Push the cart slowly so the eggs do not roll off.
cart.example_zh: 慢慢推这辆手推车，免得鸡蛋滚下去。

carton.example_en: Please recycle the milk carton after you finish your drink.
carton.example_zh: 喝完后请把牛奶纸盒拿去回收。

cashier.example_en: The cashier gave me the wrong change at the supermarket.
cashier.example_zh: 超市的收银员把零钱找错了。

celebration.example_en: The victory celebration lasted until the school gates closed.
celebration.example_zh: 胜利庆典一直持续到校门关闭。

champagne.example_en: Adults drank champagne at the wedding while we had juice.
champagne.example_zh: 婚礼上大人们喝香槟，我们喝果汁。

chant.example_en: Fans began to chant the team name as the players ran out.
chant.example_zh: 球员出场时，球迷开始反复喊着队名。

charcoal.example_en: Grandpa cooked fish over charcoal in the backyard last night.
charcoal.example_zh: 昨晚爷爷在后院用木炭烤鱼。

chase.example_en: The cat tried to chase a pigeon across the busy square.
chase.example_zh: 那只猫试图追着一只鸽子穿过热闹的广场。

checkout.example_en: There was a long queue at the checkout on Saturday afternoon.
checkout.example_zh: 星期六下午，收银台前排着长队。

cheeseburger.example_en: He ordered a cheeseburger and fries after football practice.
cheeseburger.example_zh: 足球训练后，他点了芝士汉堡和薯条。

childhood.example_en: Many of my childhood friends still live on the same street.
childhood.example_zh: 我的许多童年朋友仍然住在同一条街上。

chili.example_en: Add a little chili if you like the noodles extra spicy.
chili.example_zh: 如果你喜欢面条更辣，就加一点辣椒。

chopstick.example_en: I dropped one chopstick under the table during lunch.
chopstick.example_zh: 午饭时，我把一根筷子掉到了桌子底下。

classify.example_en: We classify leaves by shape during the biology field trip.
classify.example_zh: 生物实地考察时，我们按形状给叶子分类。

clown.example_en: A clown made balloon animals for children at the fair.
clown.example_zh: 小丑在集市上为孩子们做气球小动物。

cluck.example_en: Hens cluck loudly when someone walks near their wooden coop.
cluck.example_zh: 有人走近木鸡舍时，母鸡会大声咯咯叫。

cooperation.example_en: Good cooperation helped our group finish the project on time.
cooperation.example_zh: 良好的合作帮助我们小组按时完成了项目。

cockroach.example_en: A cockroach ran across the kitchen floor and hid under the fridge.
cockroach.example_zh: 一只蟑螂跑过厨房地板，躲到了冰箱底下。

coke.example_en: She bought a cold coke after the long bike ride home.
coke.example_zh: 长途骑车回家后，她买了一杯冰可乐。

comb.example_en: Use this comb if your hair gets messy in the wind.
comb.example_zh: 要是风把头发吹乱了，就用这把梳子。

combination.example_en: The combination of rice and grilled fish is my favourite lunch.
combination.example_zh: 米饭配烤鱼的组合是我最喜欢的午餐。

compasses.example_en: Bring your compasses tomorrow so we can draw circles in maths.
compasses.example_zh: 明天把圆规带来，数学课上我们要画圆。

complaint.example_en: Mum made a complaint because the new shoes broke in a week.
complaint.example_zh: 新鞋一个星期就坏了，妈妈提出了投诉。

compliment.example_en: Her coach gave her a compliment after the difficult match.
compliment.example_zh: 那场艰难的比赛之后，教练称赞了她。

composer.example_en: The composer visited our school and played his new song.
composer.example_zh: 那位作曲家来到我们学校，演奏了他的新歌。

conductor.example_en: The conductor raised his hands and the orchestra began to play.
conductor.example_zh: 指挥举起双手，管弦乐队开始演奏。

confident.example_en: She felt confident before the speech contest on Friday.
confident.example_zh: 星期五演讲比赛之前，她感到很自信。

conservatory.example_en: He studies piano at a conservatory near the city centre.
conservatory.example_zh: 他在市中心附近的一所音乐学院学钢琴。

consumer.example_en: Every consumer should check the price before paying at the till.
consumer.example_zh: 每位消费者在收银台付款前都应核对价格。

contestant.example_en: The youngest contestant sang a folk song and won second prize.
contestant.example_zh: 最年轻的参赛者唱了一首民歌，获得了二等奖。

cookery.example_en: Our cookery class taught us how to make tomato egg noodles.
cookery.example_zh: 我们的烹饪课教我们怎么做番茄鸡蛋面。

cormorant.example_en: A cormorant dived into the river and came up with a fish.
cormorant.example_zh: 一只鸬鹚潜入河里，衔着一条鱼浮了上来。

counsellor.example_en: The school counsellor helped him choose subjects for next year.
counsellor.example_zh: 学校辅导员帮他选定了明年的科目。

crab.example_en: We ate steamed crab with ginger at the seafood restaurant.
crab.example_zh: 我们在海鲜餐厅吃了姜蒸螃蟹。

craft.example_en: Paper cutting is a traditional craft she learned from her grandma.
craft.example_zh: 剪纸是她跟奶奶学来的一门传统手工艺。

crisp.example_en: These apple slices are crisp and sweet after a day in the fridge.
crisp.example_zh: 这些苹果片在冰箱里放了一天后又脆又甜。

crocodile.example_en: A crocodile lay still beside the pool at the wildlife park.
crocodile.example_zh: 一只鳄鱼一动不动地躺在野生动物园的水池边。

crossword.example_en: Grandma finishes the crossword in the newspaper every morning.
crossword.example_zh: 奶奶每天早上都做完报纸上的纵横填字游戏。

crown.example_en: The queen wore a gold crown in the history museum display.
crown.example_zh: 历史博物馆的展品中，女王戴着一顶金王冠。

cruelty.example_en: The film showed the cruelty of war through one family's story.
cruelty.example_zh: 这部电影通过一个家庭的故事展现了战争的残忍。

curiosity.example_en: Curiosity led him to open the old box in the attic.
curiosity.example_zh: 好奇心促使他打开了阁楼里那个旧箱子。

curly.example_en: Her curly hair gets bigger whenever the weather turns humid.
curly.example_zh: 天气变得潮湿时，她的卷发会蓬得更大。

cycling.example_en: Cycling along the river path is my favourite weekend exercise.
cycling.example_zh: 沿河骑行是我最喜欢的周末运动。

daydream.example_en: He started to daydream and missed the bus stop near school.
daydream.example_zh: 他开始做白日梦，错过了学校附近的公交站。

daytime.example_en: The museum is free in the daytime on the first Sunday.
daytime.example_zh: 博物馆在第一个星期日的白天免费开放。

decimal.example_en: Write the answer as a decimal instead of a whole number.
decimal.example_zh: 把答案写成小数，不要写成整数。

decoration.example_en: Red lanterns were the main decoration at the New Year party.
decoration.example_zh: 红灯笼是新年聚会上的主要装饰。

deluxe.example_en: They booked a deluxe room with a sea view for the holiday.
deluxe.example_zh: 他们为假期订了一间看海的豪华房间。

dependent.example_en: Young birds are dependent on their parents for food.
dependent.example_zh: 幼鸟在食物上依赖父母。

depressed.example_en: He felt depressed after losing the final match by one point.
depressed.example_zh: 决赛以一分之差落败后，他感到很沮丧。

dine.example_en: We dine at my uncle's house every Sunday evening.
dine.example_zh: 每个星期日晚上，我们都在叔叔家吃饭。

dip.example_en: Dip the dumpling in vinegar before you take a bite.
dip.example_zh: 咬一口饺子之前，先在醋里蘸一下。

dirt.example_en: There is dirt on your shoes, so leave them by the door.
dirt.example_zh: 你的鞋上沾着污垢，把它们放在门口吧。

disbelief.example_en: She stared in disbelief when her name appeared on the screen.
disbelief.example_zh: 看到自己的名字出现在屏幕上时，她难以置信地盯着看。

diver.example_en: The diver found a lost watch near the rocks by the beach.
diver.example_zh: 潜水员在海滩岩石附近找到了一块丢失的手表。

documentary.example_en: That panda documentary starts at eight on Friday evening.
documentary.example_zh: 那部熊猫纪录片在星期五晚上八点开始。

donkey.example_en: A donkey carried bags of fruit up the narrow mountain path.
donkey.example_zh: 一头驴驮着几袋水果走上狭窄的山路。

donor.example_en: The blood donor waited in a quiet room after giving blood.
donor.example_zh: 献血者献完血后在一间安静的房间里等候。

dot.example_en: Put a dot after each short answer on the test paper.
dot.example_zh: 在试卷上每道简短答案后面点一个圆点。

dough.example_en: Let the dough rest for twenty minutes before you roll it.
dough.example_zh: 擀面之前，让面团静置二十分钟。

drain.example_en: Water would not drain from the sink after we washed the rice.
drain.example_zh: 我们淘完米后，水从水槽里排不出去。

drum.example_en: He plays the drum in the school band every Thursday.
drum.example_zh: 他每个星期四在学校乐队里打鼓。

dull.example_en: The grey sky made the whole afternoon feel dull and slow.
dull.example_zh: 灰蒙蒙的天空让整个下午显得又乏味又缓慢。

dwelling.example_en: That stone dwelling has stood on the hillside for many years.
dwelling.example_zh: 那座石头住所在山坡上已经立了许多年。

eddy.example_en: An eddy spun the fallen leaves in a circle near the bridge.
eddy.example_zh: 桥附近，一个漩涡把落叶转成一个圈。

edition.example_en: This edition of the textbook includes new maps of Shenzhen.
edition.example_zh: 这一版教材收录了深圳的新地图。

effective.example_en: A short rest is more effective than another cup of coffee.
effective.example_zh: 短暂休息比再喝一杯咖啡更有效。

elastic.example_en: The waistband is elastic, so these shorts fit after lunch.
elastic.example_zh: 裤腰有弹性，所以午饭后这条短裤仍然合身。

elect.example_en: Students will elect a new class monitor next Monday morning.
elect.example_zh: 学生们将在下星期一上午选举新班长。

employee.example_en: Each employee gets a free lunch in the company canteen.
employee.example_zh: 每位雇员都能在公司食堂免费用午餐。

employer.example_en: Her employer allowed her to leave early for the match.
employer.example_zh: 雇主允许她为了看比赛提早离开。

enclose.example_en: Please enclose a photo when you send the application form.
enclose.example_zh: 寄申请表时请附上一张照片。

encyclopaedia.example_en: I looked up volcanoes in an old encyclopaedia at the library.
encyclopaedia.example_zh: 我在图书馆一本旧百科全书里查阅了火山。

euro.example_en: The ticket costs twelve euro if you buy it online today.
euro.example_zh: 如果今天在网上购买，这张票要十二欧元。

excerpt.example_en: The magazine printed an excerpt from her travel diary.
excerpt.example_zh: 杂志刊登了她旅行日记中的一段摘录。

excite.example_en: Football finals excite the whole neighbourhood every spring.
excite.example_zh: 每年春天，足球决赛都让整个社区兴奋起来。

expression.example_en: His expression changed when he saw the surprise birthday cake.
expression.example_zh: 看到惊喜生日蛋糕时，他的表情变了。

extract.example_en: The dentist had to extract a tooth that had been hurting.
extract.example_zh: 牙医不得不拔掉那颗一直作痛的牙。

eyebrow.example_en: She raised one eyebrow when I told her the strange story.
eyebrow.example_zh: 我讲起那个奇怪的故事时，她扬起了一边眉毛。

faint.example_en: A faint smell of bread came from the bakery down the street.
faint.example_zh: 街那头的面包店飘来一股淡淡的面包味。

fake.example_en: That watch looks expensive, but the logo is fake.
fake.example_zh: 那块表看起来很贵，但上面的标志是假的。

fascinate.example_en: Dinosaurs fascinate my little brother more than any cartoon.
fascinate.example_zh: 恐龙比任何动画片都更让我弟弟着迷。

feast.example_en: The family prepared a feast for Grandpa's seventieth birthday.
feast.example_zh: 家人为爷爷的七十岁生日准备了一桌盛宴。

feather.example_en: A white feather drifted down from the bird above the roof.
feather.example_zh: 一根白羽毛从屋顶上方的鸟儿身上飘了下来。

ferry.example_en: We took the ferry across the river to reach the old town.
ferry.example_zh: 我们乘渡船过河，去到那座古城。

fictional.example_en: Sherlock Holmes is a fictional detective in those London stories.
fictional.example_zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯是那些伦敦故事里的虚构侦探。

fierce.example_en: Nobody dared to pass the fierce dog outside the warehouse.
fierce.example_zh: 没有人敢从仓库外面那条凶猛的狗身边经过。

fin.example_en: The shark's fin cut through the water near the boat.
fin.example_zh: 鲨鱼的鳍在船附近划开了水面。

float.example_en: Paper boats float down the stream after the summer rain.
float.example_zh: 夏雨过后，纸船顺着小溪漂下去。

foolish.example_en: It was foolish to leave my phone on the bus seat.
foolish.example_zh: 把手机落在公交车座位上太愚蠢了。

footprint.example_en: A muddy footprint marked the clean floor near the door.
footprint.example_zh: 门边干净的地板上留着一个泥脚印。

forbidden.example_en: Phones are forbidden in the exam room from start to finish.
forbidden.example_zh: 从开始到结束，考场里都禁止使用手机。

forth.example_en: The parade moved forth down the main street after the drums started.
forth.example_zh: 鼓声响起后，游行队伍沿着大街向前走。

fortunate.example_en: We were fortunate to find seats on the crowded holiday train.
fortunate.example_zh: 我们很幸运，在拥挤的假日火车上找到了座位。

fraction.example_en: One half is a fraction, and we use it to share a pizza.
fraction.example_zh: 二分之一是一个分数，我们用它来分食一块披萨。

frame.example_en: She put the team photo in a wooden frame above her desk.
frame.example_zh: 她把团队合影放进书桌上方的木相框里。

frighten.example_en: Loud thunder can frighten the dog under the kitchen table.
frighten.example_zh: 响雷会吓到躲在厨房桌子底下的狗。

frightening.example_en: The empty alley looked frightening after the street lights went out.
frightening.example_zh: 路灯熄灭后，空荡荡的小巷看起来令人害怕。

frown.example_en: Dad will frown if you leave dirty plates in the sink.
frown.example_zh: 如果你把脏盘子留在水槽里，爸爸会皱眉。

fur.example_en: After running through the rain, the cat's fur was soaked.
fur.example_zh: 在雨里跑过之后，猫身上的软毛湿透了。

furthermore.example_en: The hotel is cheap; furthermore, it is close to the station.
furthermore.example_zh: 这家旅馆便宜；此外，它离车站很近。

fury.example_en: He shouted in fury when someone broke his new skateboard.
fury.example_zh: 有人弄坏他的新滑板时，他暴怒地大喊起来。

furious.example_en: Mum was furious because I came home two hours late.
furious.example_zh: 我晚了两个小时才回家，妈妈气坏了。

fuss.example_en: Please do not make a fuss about a small stain on your shirt.
fuss.example_zh: 衬衫上只有一小块污渍，请别大惊小怪。

garage.example_en: Dad keeps his tools and the old bike in the garage.
garage.example_zh: 爸爸把工具和旧自行车放在车库里。

gasp.example_en: Runners gasp for air after the long race around the track.
gasp.example_zh: 绕着跑道长跑结束后，选手们大口喘气。

gently.example_en: She gently placed the goldfish back into the bowl.
gently.example_zh: 她轻轻地把金鱼放回了鱼缸。

gesture.example_en: With one gesture, the coach sent the substitute onto the field.
gesture.example_zh: 教练做了一个手势，让替补队员上了场。

ghost.example_en: Some children say a ghost lives in the old school building.
ghost.example_zh: 有些孩子说老教学楼里住着一个鬼。

giant.example_en: The giant statue in the square is taller than our school building.
giant.example_zh: 广场上那座巨大的雕像比我们的教学楼还高。

ginkgo.example_en: Yellow ginkgo leaves cover the pavement outside our school in autumn.
ginkgo.example_zh: 秋天，学校外面的人行道铺满了黄色的银杏叶。

glance.example_en: She took a quick glance at the clock and ran for the bus.
glance.example_zh: 她迅速瞥了一眼时钟，然后跑去赶公交。

glutinous.example_en: Glutinous rice dumplings are a traditional food at the Dragon Boat Festival.
glutinous.example_zh: 糯米粽是端午节的传统食物。

golden.example_en: Golden sunlight filled the playground just before the bell rang.
golden.example_zh: 铃声响起前，金色的阳光洒满了操场。

goldfish.example_en: My goldfish swims in circles whenever I tap the glass.
goldfish.example_zh: 我一敲玻璃，金鱼就转着圈游。

goose.example_en: A goose chased us away from the pond in the park.
goose.example_zh: 公园池塘边，一只鹅把我们赶走了。

gorilla.example_en: The gorilla sat quietly and watched the children outside the glass.
gorilla.example_zh: 大猩猩安静地坐着，看着玻璃外面的孩子。

graceful.example_en: The dancer looked graceful as she moved across the stage.
graceful.example_zh: 舞者穿过舞台时，姿态看起来很优美。

grandchild.example_en: Every grandchild received a red envelope during the family dinner.
grandchild.example_zh: 家庭晚宴上，每个孙辈都收到了一个红包。

grandma.example_en: Grandma makes dumplings whenever we visit her on Saturday.
grandma.example_zh: 每星期六我们去看她时，奶奶都会包饺子。

grandpa.example_en: Grandpa walks in the park every morning before breakfast.
grandpa.example_zh: 爷爷每天早饭前都在公园里散步。

granny.example_en: My granny taught me how to sew a button onto a shirt.
granny.example_zh: 外婆教我怎样把纽扣缝到衬衫上。

graph.example_en: Draw a graph to show how the temperature changed this week.
graph.example_zh: 画一张图表，显示这周气温是怎样变化的。

grate.example_en: Grate some cheese over the pasta before you serve it.
grate.example_zh: 上桌之前，在意大利面上磨一些奶酪。

gratitude.example_en: She expressed her gratitude by writing a card to the coach.
gratitude.example_zh: 她给教练写了一张卡片，以此来表达感激。

grid.example_en: Copy the numbers into the grid before you start the puzzle.
grid.example_zh: 开始做谜题之前，先把数字抄进网格里。

grin.example_en: He could not hide a grin when his team scored the winner.
grin.example_zh: 球队打进制胜球时，他忍不住咧嘴一笑。

hairbrush.example_en: I cannot find my hairbrush, so my hair is a mess today.
hairbrush.example_zh: 我找不到发刷，所以今天头发乱糟糟的。

hairstyle.example_en: She changed her hairstyle before the school photo last week.
hairstyle.example_zh: 上周学校拍照之前，她换了发型。

handcuff.example_en: During the drill, the officer locked one handcuff around the chair leg.
handcuff.example_zh: 演练时，警官把一只手铐锁在了椅腿上。

handwritten.example_en: I prefer a handwritten card to a message sent on the phone.
handwritten.example_zh: 比起手机上发来的消息，我更喜欢手写的卡片。

harbour.example_en: Fishing boats returned to the harbour before the storm arrived.
harbour.example_zh: 暴风雨到来之前，渔船返回了港口。

harry.example_en: Harry forgot his sports shoes and had to borrow a pair.
harry.example_zh: 哈里忘了带运动鞋，只好借了一双。

hawker.example_en: A hawker sold grilled corn outside the stadium after the match.
hawker.example_zh: 比赛结束后，一名小贩在体育场外卖烤玉米。

heaven.example_en: After the long hike, a cold drink felt like heaven.
heaven.example_zh: 长途徒步之后，一杯冷饮简直像到了天堂。

helicopter.example_en: A helicopter flew low over the beach during the rescue drill.
helicopter.example_zh: 救援演练时，一架直升机低低地飞过海滩。

hesitation.example_en: Without hesitation, she jumped into the pool to help her friend.
hesitation.example_zh: 她毫不犹豫地跳进泳池去帮朋友。
